messages:
alex: kicking off observability bring-up for eu-west-3 GPU cluster. goal: full stack (metrics/logs/traces), baseline dashboards, and a basic alerting bundle. timeline: bootstrap tomorrow morning. looking for a validation checklist + cost controls.

kyra: +1. main things to watch: prometheus cardinality from ML jobs, log volume from worker pods, and trace sampling for long running inferences.

tim: low-level checklist i use:
1) infra: VPC + subnets + egress NATs configured for observability endpoints.
2) node labels: node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=true and region=eu-west-3 set on GPU pools.
3) service accounts & IAM for remote-write / S3 retention.
4) TLS certs and KMS for any secrets.

lina: will the GPU nodes send node-exporter metrics? we should add a scrape config that drops high-cardinality labels from job containers (model_id, request_id) so prometheus doesn't explode.

alex: yes — we'll run node-exporter + cadvisor on all nodes. tim: can you paste the relabel snippet you mentioned yesterday?

tim: here you go:
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model_id]
    action: replace
    regex: .*\n    replacement: "__droplabel__"
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: request_id|session_id|model_id
```
use labeldrop before remote_write.

kyra: for logs: Fluent Bit on the node pool, forward to Loki (s3 index + chunk storage). Important config items: multiline, buffer limits, and rate-limits so a runaway job doesn't spike egress.

sam: deploy-bot shows kube cluster create passed for eu-west-3 at 1763246200. next step: helm deploy observability chart.

deploy-bot: [deploy] started helm release observability/eu-west-3 at 1763246455

alex: proposed helm commands for bootstrap (helm values are simplified, use terraform module for prod infra):
```bash
helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo add grafana https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts
helm install prom-stack prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n observability -f eu-west-3-prom-values.yaml
helm install loki grafana/loki -n observability -f eu-west-3-loki-values.yaml
helm install tempo grafana/tempo -n observability -f eu-west-3-tempo-values.yaml
```

lina: validation checks after helm:
- Prometheus pods ready and target count matches expected node-exporter + service monitors.
- Grafana accessible via internal LB + dashboards imported.
- Loki ingestion rate sane (<= 50MB/s during smoke test).
- Tempo sampling rate set to 1-5% for production GPU workers.
- OTel collector running with resource limits.

tim: add these smoke commands:
```bash
kubectl -n observability get pods
kubectl -n observability exec deploy/prometheus-server -- curl -sS http://localhost:9090/api/v1/targets | jq .data.activeTargets | wc -l
# quick query to confirm metrics
kubectl -n observability exec deploy/prometheus-server -- curl -sS 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=up' | jq .data.result | head -n 5
```

kyra: alerting templates (minimum):
- prometheus: NodeExporterDown (2m), kubelet_down (2m), high_disk_io (5m), prometheus_rule_evaluation_fail (5m)
- application: inference_latency_high > p95 > 2s for 5m, gpu_utilization_high > 95% for 10m (only when expected load > 30%)
- logs: error_rate > 1% over 10m (with grouping by service, not by request_id)

alex: cost controls:
- set Prometheus retention to 15d for this region initially, then tune.
- remote_write to central long-term store for 90d at lower resolution (downsampled).
- Loki: index to s3, set chunk_target_size_mb=1 and retention 30d.
- limit trace sampling to 1%.
- enable metrics rewrite to drop costly metrics (per tim's relabeling).

sam: who owns the handoff? alex will do initial verification, then @oncall rotation (sam) will take over after 12h stable window. create PD escalation and add alert runbooks into runbook folder.

lina: PR checklist for dashboards: include panels for cluster-level GPU allocation, per-node memory pressure, per-pod tokenized requests/sec, and extreme tail latency panel. attach CSV of sample queries.

tim: small nit — ensure cluster monitoring IAM policies allow Prometheus remote_write to the ingestion endpoint only; avoid broad S3 keys. least privilege.

alex: agreed. next steps:
- tim: land relabel rules and helm values today.
- kyra: craft Loki and Fluent Bit rate limits + retention configs.
- lina: prepare dashboard PR and trace sampling policy.
- sam: create PD escalation + create doc in /runbooks/observability/eu-west-3.md and assign incident responder.

kyra: also add a validation metric in the bootstrap pipeline that checks cardinality of metrics series (prometheus_tsdb_head_series) and fail the job if > 5M series.

alex: perfect. i'll post a final checklist and ETA here once the infra PRs are merged. thanks all :rocket:
